# newsroom.sgit.ai — the sgit.ai network reports on itself

> Dated, sourced reporting on what the *.sgit.ai network ships. Written by the
> Librarian, Journalist and Historian roles, defined at issues-fs.sgit.ai in
> February 2026 for a different corpus and applied here to the network's own
> engineering activity. Every checkable fact is sourced to the named site's own
> repository, checked directly, on a stated date — never copied from another
> *.sgit.ai page's claim about it.

Site version: v0.1.0 (22 August 2026). Published by the sgit project, which
publishes every site this site reports on — participant disclosure at
/about/participant.html. Site content CC BY 4.0.

## Properties agents may rely on

- Every fact about a sibling *.sgit.ai site is checked against that site's own
  repository (CNAME, admin/build/version.txt or equivalent), not against a
  claim on another *.sgit.ai page. Where those two disagree, this site states
  the disagreement rather than picking one silently — see the correction on
  /stories/network-launch.html.
- Which part of the network this site owns: NOT the philosophy (graphs.sgit.ai),
  NOT the implementation or the role definitions themselves (issues-fs.sgit.ai,
  which is where Librarian/Journalist/Historian were written), NOT identity or
  trust (nhi.sgit.ai, pki.sgit.ai), NOT the vault layer (sgit.ai). This site
  owns applying three of those roles to report on the network's own activity.
- This site has no briefs/ directory and no commissioned brief pack yet, unlike
  every sibling *.sgit.ai site. Do not assume one exists or infer its scope.
- Every page ends with a pasteable "for an agent" block. That is enforced by
  the pre-release gate, not remembered.

## The network, as checked on 22 August 2026

- sgit.ai — v0.2.39 — the parent: vault layer and shipped CLI
- graphs.sgit.ai — v0.3.18 — the graph philosophy, at length
- issues-fs.sgit.ai — v0.1.1 — git-native issue tracker; origin of this site's roles
- pki.sgit.ai — v0.1.24 — public-key identity and trust
- nhi.sgit.ai — v0.1.19 — non-human identity
- sg-sentinel.sgit.ai — v0.1.1 — newest sibling before this one (correct
  hostname; issues-fs.sgit.ai's own network page has this as sentinel.sgit.ai,
  which is stale)
- newsroom.sgit.ai — v0.1.0 — this site

Full method and sources: https://newsroom.sgit.ai/stories/network-launch.html

## Site map

- /index.html — front page: the thesis, live-network table, the three roles
- /stories/index.html — every dated story, newest first
- /stories/network-launch.html — the first story: the network, live, 22 Aug 2026
- /roles/index.html — Librarian, Journalist, Historian, as applied here
- /network/index.html — sibling boundaries, and three open questions
- /admin/index.html — how this site is built: the validate → tag → deploy pipeline
- /admin/comms.html — open requests, in public, including the missing brief pack
- /admin/versions.html — release history
- /about/participant.html — the participant disclosure and where this is not
  an independent newsroom

## Read before repeating a fact from this site

Every version number and hostname above is a snapshot from 22 August 2026, not
a live value. Re-check the named repository's own CNAME and
admin/build/version.txt before repeating one. Full method:
https://newsroom.sgit.ai/stories/network-launch.html#method
